annotations.title: US → Nigeria air shipping estimate (free, Doos Logistics public rates)

description: Free. Floor estimate for an air shipment from Doos Logistics' Fort Worth, TX hub to Lagos, built only from Doos's published rates; unpublished charges are listed, never guessed. Prohibited and restricted items (liquid, perishable, hazmat) get no price: the result is estimate_available:false with a reason (prohibited_item or restricted_item). Ocean not offered. Links to book and pay Doos directly for priced items. Independent estimate from Ni Biashara LLC. Not affiliated with Doos Logistics. You book and pay Doos Logistics directly. Estimates from Doos's public rates retrieved 2026-10-19. No payment: this tool returns the estimate itself.
